Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a â€œWHITEâ€ speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.

The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a â€œPINKâ€ speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.

2018-09-26 Item 08D Wireless Emergency Alert System
8E.
Renewable Diesel Fuel Delivery Agreement. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Wilson
City Council authorizes the City Manager, or her designee, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute an agreement between the City of Encinitas and IPC (USA), Inc. to provide renewable diesel fuel delivery to the Public Works yard (160 Calle Magdalena), Fire Station #3 (801 Orpheus Avenue) and Fire Station #4 (2011 Village Park Way) for one initial three-year term, and authorize the City Manager to extend the agreement for two (2) additional one-year periods for a total agreement term not to exceed five years and a not to exceed contract amount of $550,000.
2018-09-26 Item 08E Renewable Diesel Fuel

Authorization to procure Cisco networking and phone equipment. Contact Person: IT Operations Supervisor Contreras

2018-09-26 Item 08F Authorization to Procure Cisco Networking and Phone Equipment Pages 604 - 1205

2018-09-26 Item 08G Authorization to Procure Dell Hardware
8H.

2018-09-26 Item 08H As-Needed Information Technology (IT) Security and Disaster Recovery (DR) Contracts

2018-09-26 Item 08I Authorization to Procure Hewlett Packard (HP) Servers, Data Storage and to Renew Support and Maintenance on Existing Hardware
8J.
Public Hearing regarding the introduction of City Council Ordinance No. 2018-12 to adopt a modification suggested by the California Coastal Commission to City Council Ordinance No. 2017-03, which amended Chapters 23.08 (Design Review) and 23.24 (Grading, Erosion and Sediment Control) and Titles 24 (Subdivisions) and 30 (Zoning) of the Encinitas Municipal Code and the Cardiff-by-the-Sea, Downtown Encinitas, Encinitas Ranch and North 101 Corridor Specific Plans to address changes in state laws, correct errors and improve existing regulations. CASE NO: 16-141 ZA/SPA/LCPA; LOCATION: Citywide. Contact Person: Associate Planner Winter
1) Conduct the public hearing; and 2) Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2018-12, titled â€œAn Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Adopting a Modification Suggested by the California Coastal Commission to City Council Ordinance No. 2017-03, which Adopted Amendments to Chapters 23.08 (Design Review) and 23.24 (Grading, Erosion and Sediment Control) and Titles 24 (Subdivisions) and 30 (Zoning) of the Encinitas Municipal Code and the Cardiff-by-the-Sea, Downtown Encinitas, Encinitas Ranch and North 101 Corridor Specific Plans to Address Changes in State Laws, Correct Errors and Improve Existing Regulations.â€

Agreement for Traffic Signal Maintenance and Repair Services. Contact Person: City Traffic Engineer Bandegan
City Council authorizes the City Manager, in conjunction with the City Attorney, to execute an agreement for traffic signal maintenance and repair services in substantial form for an initial term expiring on June 30, 2020 (20 months) and an option for the City Manager to extend the agreement for two (2) years. The agreement amount for the initial term is not to exceed $492,805. The amount for the option to extend will be for an entire two-year period and not exceed $575,366 plus a CPI adjustment.

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
